rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that did not achieve the intended result.

example.english: After all that work, the event was still unsuccessful.
example.traditional: 今次個活動搞咗咁耐，最後都係唔成功。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 wut6 dung6 gaau2 zo2 gam3 noi6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 m4 sing4 gung1

rows.note: Use this when stressing that an attempt, plan, or project failed rather than merely fell short.

example.english: The plan was unsuccessful because it was misguided from the start.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃一開始就諗錯方向，結果徹底失敗。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jat1 hoi1 ci2 zau6 nam2 co3 fong1 hoeng3 git3 gwo2 cit3 dai2 sat1 baai6
